question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Causing or wanting to cause harm or evil to someone
solution:
The correct answer is **"Malevolent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Malevolent"** means having or showing a desire to harm others. (बुरा चाहनेवाला या अनिष्ट करनेवाला; ईर्ष्यालु)

 
 
• **Example**: *The central character is a **malevolent**__ witch out for revenge.*
